note: Light n belongs to pushbutton n: the page states 'pushbuttons 1, 2 or 3 are pushed separately lights 1, 2 or 3 respectively will come on'. Asserted: individual presses (light n on, the other two off, per 'the single light'); after pushing 2 and 3 together, pushing either lights 2 and 3; after pushing all three together, pushing any one lights all three (the pairing is not forgotten in between, as the page continues the sequence). Not asserted: lamp states after release, light 1 alone after the 2+3 association, and the state after the 'forget' button (pushbutton 6), since the page states no observable beyond 'ready to learn'. The forget press is scripted but carries no expect.
